STACKER_OVERLAY_GHOST_RANGE_TOOLTIP: Number of ghost frames to show (before and after, each)

STACKER_OVERLAY_GROUP_TOOLTIP: Group (a set of bones). A pose key bundles the keys of this group's curves
STACKER_OVERLAY_INSERT_TOOLTIP: Insert the same pose after the current pose key and push the following keys back (on a frame without a pose key, keys the group)
STACKER_OVERLAY_INTERVAL_TOOLTIP: Number of frames to the next pose key. Changing it shifts all following keys

STACKER_OVERLAY_LOOP_TOOLTIP: Copy the first pose key to the end (fixing the first also updates the last)
